C1425.title: ETC Hit by 51% Attack: Over 10x Profit in 4 Hours
C1425.summary: On January 7, 2019, an attacker executed a 51% attack on Ethereum Classic (ETC), double-spending at least 4 transactions totaling 54,200 ETC worth $271,000 within 4 hours. The attack cost approximately $5,168 per hour, with a total cost of around $20,672, yielding over 10x profit.
